# spec/pr/exports

`spec/pr/exports` — every export a PR adds to or changes in a contract's
target module is tested by the contract (one of its `functions`) or listed
in its `outOfScope` with a reason, so no new surface lands untested. An
export is compared by its declaration's text (gitdiffExports) between the
fork point from the base and the work tree. Deleting an export the contract
tests fails too: its test can no longer build. A change that adds an export
the scanner cannot name or resolve (`export *`, a re-export from another
module, `export { a }` of an imported `a`) fails closed.

Generated from [src/spec/pr/exports.ts](https://github.com/amritk/vector/blob/main/src/spec/pr/exports.ts).

### exportsDiff

The exports that differ between two versions of a module: added and
changed in the order the new text declares them, then the deleted in the
order the old one did. An export the scanner cannot name or resolve is
"unnamed" unless the old text has it word for word.

```ts
function exportsDiff(before: string, after: string): ExportsChange[]
```

<scalar-field name="before" type="string" required>

the module at the fork point; "" when it did not exist

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="after" type="string" required>

the module now; "" when it is gone

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="ExportsChange[]">

the changes

</scalar-field>

### exportsJudgeAll

Judges a module's changed exports against every contract that targets it:
an export is covered when any of them tests it, or, when none does, any
lists it in outOfScope with a reason. One module tested by two specs (HMAC
by RFC 4231, PBKDF2 by RFC 7914) is judged on what the two cover together,
where each alone leaves the other's functions uncovered.

```ts
function exportsJudgeAll(
  r: PrReport,
  cs: Contract[],
  changes: ExportsChange[],
  where: string,
): void
```

<scalar-field name="r" type="PrReport" required>

the report to fill

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="cs" type="Contract[]" required>

the contracts, all targeting the module

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="changes" type="ExportsChange[]" required>

the exports that changed (exportsDiff)

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="where" type="string" required>

what each line starts with: "" for one module, `<file>: ` when the report covers several

</scalar-field>

### exportsCheck

Checks the exports a change makes to a contract's target module, in the
nish checkout at `nishRoot`, against its fork point from `base`.

```ts
function exportsCheck(
  contractPath: string,
  nishRoot: string,
  base: string,
): Result<PrReport, string>
```

<scalar-field name="contractPath" type="string" required>

the contract file

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="nishRoot" type="string" required>

the nish checkout, a git work tree, whose std/ holds the module

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="base" type="string" required>

the ref the change is against

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="Result&lt;PrReport, string&gt;">

the report, or `Err` when the contract cannot be read, its target

</scalar-field>

### exportsCheckAll

Checks the exports a change makes to every module the contracts target:
each module once, against all the contracts that target it (exportsJudgeAll).

```ts
function exportsCheckAll(
  contractPaths: string[],
  nishRoot: string,
  base: string,
): Result<PrReport, string>
```

<scalar-field name="contractPaths" type="string[]" required>

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="nishRoot" type="string" required>

</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="base" type="string" required>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="Result&lt;PrReport, string&gt;">
